_comment: Gear (docs/ROADMAP.md 0.7.2, Appendix H): five slots, fifteen items, one per slot and rarity. An item is a rule or a yield, never a damage percentage. `rules` use the rule ids of runes.json and merge with them in inventory/gear.py: reach, sight, threshold, finish and chest reach take the largest; rings and extras add; scales multiply; COIN_PCT.<kind> adds into the sheet's coin percentages. `icon` is the app's GameIcon name. Only gear worn in an open slot counts. The consumables are kept as counts on the loadout.

items.name: Tin Bell
items.text: Creatures show up from 500 m away.

items.name: Drover's Bell
items.text: Your opening blow on a creature is 25% stronger.

items.name: The Unrung Bell
items.text: A creature left with less than a tenth of its health is defeated.

items.name: Candle Stub
items.text: One more ring of tiles explored around each new tile.

items.name: Bull's-eye Lantern
items.text: Map pieces reveal half as much again.

items.name: Wrecker's Light
items.text: Chests open when your journey passes within 150 m.

items.name: Tinker's Satchel
items.text: 20% more coins from chests, and items sell for more.

items.name: Poacher's Pocket
items.text: Better finds: items drop more often and rarer.

items.name: Folded Map
items.text: One more quest on the quest board.

items.name: Pedlar's Road-book
items.text: Optional quest goals give double XP.

items.name: Cartographer's Atlas
items.text: Each new tile counts 1.25 for exploring.

items.name: Hagstone
items.text: Rune shapes are matched as kindly as a Wizard's.

items.name: Rowan Twig
items.text: A rune shape reaches creatures up to 1.5 km away.

items.name: Runesmith's Nail
items.text: A woken rune counts one more rank.

consumables.name: Lamp
consumables.text: Lights a lamp for free: a creature comes to the place you pick.

consumables.name: Map piece
consumables.text: Shows the tiles around the nearest hidden place, up to 5 km away.

consumables.name: Rest token
consumables.text: Keeps your streak going over one missed day. It is used by itself.

consumables.name: Sealed chest (Common)
consumables.text: Holds one Common item. Open it when your journey is over.

consumables.name: Sealed chest (Rare)
consumables.text: Holds one Rare item. Open it when your journey is over.
